messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: { "description": "A quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile standing on a light ground, combining the head, fur and general posture of a gray wolf with the armored exoskeleton of a crab. The head and neck are covered in dense gray and white wolf fur with yellow eyes and a black nose, while the entire torso, back, neck, legs and tail are encased in overlapping glossy dark bluish-black segmented plates with a large domed carapace on the mid-back. The underside of the body, neck and tail is a contrasting pale cream with segmented plating. The two front limbs are thick, heavily armored and terminate in large bumpy crab-like pincers that rest on the ground, and the two hind limbs are armored and terminate in clawed paws. A long, tapering, heavily plated tail extends from the rear, dark on top and pale below, with some fur visible at its base.", "parts": [ { "part": "head", "looks_like": "wolf-like head at the anterior end, pointed muzzle, black nose, yellow eyes with dark pupils, gray fur on crown and cheeks fading to white on muzzle, chin and throat, mouth closed", "where": "frontmost end of the body, facing right" }, { "part": "ears", "looks_like": "two erect, triangular, pointed ears with gray outer fur and darker interior, furry texture", "where": "on top of the head, one slightly behind the other in profile" }, { "part": "mane", "looks_like": "thick shaggy ruff of longer gray and white fur", "where": "encircling the neck from behind the ears, along the top of the neck and down the throat and chest" }, { "part": "legs", "looks_like": "four thick, jointed, heavily armored limbs with overlapping dark plates and visible joints; front pair more robust with spiny bumpy texture, hind pair with a distinct knee bend", "where": "under the torso, two front under the chest, two hind under the hips, all contacting the ground" }, { "part": "feet", "looks_like": "front feet are large dark bumpy crab chelae/pincers with curved black tips and small tubercles; hind feet are armored paws with segmented plates and four black claws/nails each", "where": "at the distal ends of the legs, front pincers on the ground at the front, clawed paws at the rear" }, { "part": "tail", "looks_like": "long, tapering, segmented tail covered dorsally in overlapping dark plates and ventrally in pale cream plates, with short fur visible at the base and along the underside, tip pointed and slightly brushy", "where": "extending rearward from the hips, curving slightly downward" }, { "part": "shell", "looks_like": "large, glossy, dome-shaped dark carapace with a scalloped and spiny outer margin and a slightly worn, mottled surface with a small light patch", "where": "on the mid-back, sitting atop the segmented back plates, behind the neck plates" }, { "part": "plates", "looks_like": "numerous overlapping semi-circular to band-like hard plates, dark bluish-black and glossy on the back, sides, neck and outer legs, and pale cream and matte on the belly, inner neck and underside of tail;
